person: Nadia Rahimi, independent IT infrastructure consultant based in Singapore who flies to client sites most weeks and is learning Mandarin

mail.subject: Your November hot desk plan
mail.body: Hi Nadia, you have 6 day passes left on your November plan. Unused passes don't roll over. Meeting rooms are SGD 25 an hour for members.

mail.subject: Your membership renews soon
mail.body: Hi Nadia, your Ironleaf membership renews in 14 days at SGD 128 a month. Travelling a lot? You can freeze your membership for up to 2 months for SGD 15 a month; just tell the front desk before the renewal date.

mail.subject: Your trip receipt
mail.body: Trip: Seri Bukit Residences to Singapore T2, 22.1 km. Fare SGD 28.40, paid by card. Driver: Kumaran.

mail.subject: This week: zero trust for mid-size firms
mail.body: In this issue: why mid-size firms stall on zero trust, a field guide to backup restore testing, and five questions to ask before a core switch refresh.

mail.subject: Cutover date confirmed
mail.body: Hi Nadia, thanks for the on-site days. The network cutover is confirmed for three weeks from tomorrow. The change window is 22:00 to 04:00 local, and we need you on site from 18:00 that day. Mei will send the run sheet. – Arnav

mail.subject: Your trip receipt
mail.body: Trip: Singapore T2 to Seri Bukit Residences, 23.4 km. Fare SGD 31.20, paid by card. Driver: Hui Min.

mail.subject: HSK 3 registration closing soon
mail.body: Dear candidate, registration for the HSK 3 paper exam closes in 9 days. The next exam is on a Sunday about six weeks from now. The fee is SGD 75. Please register online with your passport details.

mail.subject: Booking confirmed – Bayan Tinggi
mail.body: Booking ref QX7HRT. SM 231 Singapore to Bayan Tinggi, next Thursday morning, seat 14A. SM 236 Bayan Tinggi to Singapore, next Friday evening, seat 22C. Fare SGD 486.00 charged to your card. 25 kg checked bag included. Online check-in opens 48 hours before departure.

mail.subject: Reservation CC-55812
mail.body: Dear Ms Rahimi, your room is confirmed for 1 night, arriving next Thursday. Rate SGD 168 including breakfast. Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 11:00. We can hold luggage before check-in.

mail.subject: Your card statement is ready
mail.body: Statement balance: SGD 3,412.60. Minimum payment: SGD 50.00. Payment due in 18 days. Foreign currency transactions this period: 9.

mail.subject: Readout – restore times
mail.body: Nadia, could you include the restore-time test results in the readout? Our board will ask whether we meet the 4-hour restore target for the patient records system. – Kofi

mail.subject: Payment sent – NR-2026-031
mail.body: Payment of SGD 18,600.00 for invoice NR-2026-031 has been sent. Please allow 3 working days for it to reach your account.

mail.subject: HSK 3 mock test
mail.body: Hi Nadia, the HSK 3 mock test is two weeks from tomorrow in the morning, at the studio. Please bring a pencil, an eraser and your student ID. The fee is SGD 35, payable at the front desk.

mail.subject: Birthday brunch!
mail.body: Nads! Brunch for my birthday a week on Sunday at The Greenhouse Table. No presents needed... but if you insist, I'm collecting enamel pins, haha. Farid's coming too. – Jas

mail.subject: Invoice NR-2026-029 approved
mail.body: Dear Nadia, invoice NR-2026-029 for SGD 9,450.00 is approved. Payment will be made in 30 days, per our terms.

mail.subject: Water supply interruption
mail.body: Dear residents, the water supply will be shut off next Saturday from 9am to 1pm for tank cleaning. Please store water beforehand. We apologise for the inconvenience.

mail.subject: Quote Q-7781 – Halcyon core switches
mail.body: Hi Nadia, as requested: 12 core switches at SGD 4,350 each, lead time 6 weeks from order. This quote is valid for 14 days. – Benedikt, Zentrix Networks

mail.subject: Travel expenses for the review
mail.body: Hi Nadia, a note on expenses for the security review: under our contract, hotels up to SGD 200 a night and economy flights are reimbursable. Anything above that needs written approval in advance. – Amara, Lumora Bank Procurement

mail.subject: Kickoff a week tomorrow
mail.body: Dear Nadia, looking forward to the kickoff a week tomorrow, in the afternoon. Your access badge will be ready at security desk B. Please send your signed NDA before then. The dress code on site is business formal. – Hiroshi

mail.subject: Servicing confirmed
mail.body: Hi Nadia, your aircon servicing is confirmed for this coming Saturday afternoon. Technician: Ah Seng. The fee is SGD 90 for 3 units, payable by bank transfer after the job.

mail.subject: Dad's 65th
mail.body: Beta, Dad's 65th is the Saturday after next. Dinner at home at 7, just family. Leila is doing the cake. Please don't be on a plane that day!

mail.subject: Your bill
mail.body: Your bill of SGD 62.40 will be auto-debited in 5 days. It includes roaming charges of SGD 18.00 from Port Selvara.

mail.subject: Booking confirmed – Nusarang
mail.body: Booking ref LM4PZD. SM 508 Singapore to Nusarang, next Monday morning, seat 11F. SM 515 Nusarang to Singapore, that Thursday afternoon, seat 18A. Fare SGD 712.00 charged to your card.

mail.subject: Reservation HL-90233
mail.body: Dear Ms Rahimi, we look forward to welcoming you for 3 nights, checking in next Monday and checking out on Thursday. Rate SGD 214 per night, room only. Free cancellation until 48 hours before check-in.

mail.subject: GST return and receipts
mail.body: Hi Nadia, your quarterly GST return is due in 12 days. Please send me your October expense receipts, especially flights and hotels, by this Friday so I have time to prepare it. – Kwame

mail.subject: Saturday?
mail.body: Hi Nadia! Saturday at Kopi Lantern still good? This time 45 minutes Mandarin then 45 English. Could we spend the English part on my job interview answers? 谢谢!

mail.subject: Great ride
mail.body: Great ride yesterday, 42 km! Same time next Sunday? Also you still owe me SGD 24 for the inner tube from the bike shop, no rush.

mail.subject: e-Arrival approved
mail.body: Your e-Arrival card NV-301874 is approved. Present it with your passport at immigration. It is valid for 30 days from today.

mail.subject: PT sessions
mail.body: Hey Nadia, just a heads up you have 3 PT sessions left in your package, and they expire at the end of the month. – Rafael

mail.subject: Thursday workshop – agenda
mail.body: Hi Nadia, for Thursday's workshop we're in Meeting Room Kenanga on level 4. Please bring your laptop with the audit scripts. Your visitor pass is at reception; bring your passport. Lunch is provided, and Dr. Kofi Mensah will join from 2pm. – Siti

mail.subject: Steering committee
mail.body: Nadia, could we move the steering committee on Monday week an hour earlier? Grace has a clash. – Arnav

mail.subject: Actions from Monday's review
mail.body: Thanks for Monday's firewall review. Actions: close the 3 open inbound rules, rotate the admin keys within 10 days, and send the final report by the end of next week. – Priyanka

mail.subject: Term 4 invoice
mail.body: Hi Nadia, your Term 4 invoice is SGD 640 for 16 lessons, due in 7 days. Term 5 enrolment opens next week.

mail.subject: Homework for Thursday
mail.body: Nadia, homework for Thursday: write 10 sentences using 把, and learn vocabulary list 14 (30 words). We'll have a short dictation quiz. 加油! – Chen Laoshi

mail.subject: Tarts + pickup
mail.body: Can you bring back pineapple tarts from Bayan Tinggi? Mum loves them. And send me your flight times, I'll pick you up when you're back on Thursday next week.

mail.subject: Out for delivery tomorrow
mail.body: Your parcel (noise-cancelling headphones) will be delivered to your condo locker tomorrow. Locker code: 4471. Please collect within 3 days.

mail.subject: Annual travel policy renewal
mail.body: Your annual travel insurance policy renews in 10 days. The renewal premium is SGD 289, which includes cover for business equipment up to SGD 5,000.

mail.subject: Small change for Friday
mail.body: Hi Nadia, a small change: Friday's readout will now be in the boardroom on level 7, and our CIO needs it to finish by 11:30 instead of 12. – Siti

mail.subject: Team dinner Wednesday
mail.body: Hi Nadia, Hiroshi asked me to book the team dinner next Wednesday; it's at Saffron Pier for 4 of us. Any dietary needs? Dress is smart casual. – Amara

mail.subject: Ahead of today's sync
mail.body: Morning Nadia, in today's sync I'll present the VLAN plan. Also, the change freeze starts Friday next week. – Mei
